page.layout: One page of text, one column, with no margin notes. At the top: running head "Jo. Morinus" and page number 168. Below: the continuation of a letter, a date line, the heading "EPIST. XIV.", an argument summary, and the salutation. At the lower right: catchword "Erube-".

main_text.l: comparatione ista judicabo: non refert è
neque opus est, ut in notando capite
labores; facile unde evulsum sit conjici-
am, atque iterum illud cum Pentateucho
iam ad te rescribam; spero plane, vir Nob-
concessurum, beneficiumque, quo me jam devinctum
aturum. Vale atque ut me plurimum ames,
Petrus à Valle Peregrinus de suo
sectis in Asia didicerit, fusius declarat.

l.i: Rev. Patri atque eruditissimo Domino meo Patri Joanni Morino,
Congregationis Oratorii Presbytero Petrus à Valle Peregrinus S. P. D[?].

page.notes: The ink blot at the end of the salutation covers the letter "D" of "S. P. D."; the reading is uncertain. The running head is printed in small capitals. The catchword is hyphenated and kept as printed.
